name: minigraf_retract
description: Retract a fact from Minigraf's graph memory. Retraction records a new fact with asserted=false — the original stays in history for bi-temporal auditing.

reason.description: Why this fact is being retracted. Forces you to justify the removal.

valid_at.description: Optional. When the fact stopped being true in the world, if not now -- e.g. the date a decision was superseded. Closes each fact's valid window at that time instead of removing it, so :valid-at queries still see when it applied. YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO 8601 datetime; past or present, after the fact's own valid-from; literal [e a v] triples only. A '; valid-at: <date>' line in facts is read the same way.
